718100101.text: Ugh. How am I supposed to write my thesis like this? What should I do...

718100103.text: I— What? Oh! It's you! Do you still remember me?

718100104.text: I was that, uh, person you found in a Treasure Hoarder cage down in Lingju Pass. Heh, in any case, thank you for saving me.

718100106.text: Well, uh, after being rescued by you, I went to look for Soraya at Wangshu Inn. By a stroke of luck, I was able to find her.

718100107.text: Soraya's a really good person — not only did she treat me to a meal, but she also helped me re-organize my notes.

718100108.text: But... she told me afterward that the topic that I'd chosen has already been the subject of many prior theses at the Akademiya.

718100109.text: Unless I were to write an exceptional thesis, there's no way that I'll pass... She advised me to change angles — for example, I could write about something related to the elements.

718100110.text: But since I don't have a Vision and can't use the elements, I have no idea where to begin...

718100111.text: So there was nothing for it but to come to the city to try my luck and see if I could find any material here.

718100112.text: Wait... When you saved me back then, you fought in a very unique manner...

718100113.text: Do you have a Vision, by any chance?

718100115.text: Huh? You can fight in that manner without possessing a Vision? How can that be?

718100116.text: No, never mind. It's a very long story, no doubt... Either way, I have something to ask of you.

718100117.text: Could you demonstrate your manner of fighting to me? Perhaps I might discern something that can be used to refine my thesis...

718100118.text: Please help me out! If I don't finish this thesis, I'll be dead meat when I return to the Akademiya...

718100120.text: Thank you so much! Let's go outside, then.

718100121.text: I recall noticing a group of hilichurls around these parts. Show me your fighting style, using them as your target!

718100123.text: Oh, it's a very, very frightening place. I wake up sobbing every time I dream of it.

718100124.text: I'd rather stay in that Treasure Hoarder cage than have to do another draft or thesis defense.

718100125.text: Alright, that's enough about the Akademiya...

718100126.text: I recall noticing a group of hilichurls around these parts. Show me your fighting style, using them as your target!

718100201.text: Wow... Your fighting style really is quite unique.

718100202.text: By the way, I've also heard that Vision wielders can sense the presence of elements. I believe it's known as Elemental Sight...

718100203.text: Though you don't have a Vision, I've seen you manipulate elemental energy — so you should have this ability, right?

718100204.text: I happened upon a few slimes nearby, so could you demonstrate Elemental Sight? You can use it to find those slimes.

subQuests.subQuestName: Use Elemental Sight to find the slimes

718100401.text: Huh, you've used Elemental Sight already?

718100402.text: Are there elemental traces nearby? Strange... I don't sense anything.

718100301.text: Haha, from the perspective of someone without a Vision like myself, I didn't notice your use of Elemental Sight at all...

718100302.text: I suppose that might be something that only other Vision wielders can sense.

718100303.text: Still, thanks for demonstrating so many things to me.

718100304.text: *sigh* How I wish I had a Vision... Having an Electro Vision would be the best. Not only would it look cool, I could defend myself, too.

718100305.text: Hmm, no — an Electro Vision would probably be the least attainable of all...

718100306.text: I'm sure you can get one if you work hard.

718100307.text: No, it won't happen, no matter how hard I work—

718100308.text: Wait. Don't you know? It seems that nobody has obtained an Electro Vision for a whole year now.

718100309.text: I've heard that the Akademiya has been researching this matter for a while now, and they have concluded that the lack of Electro Visions granted to mortals is the will of the Electro Archon.

718100310.text: I've also heard it said that Inazuma's Electro Archon has proclaimed a "Vision Hunt Decree," which has aimed to confiscate the majority of all Visions from Vision wielders throughout Inazuma.

718100311.text: Those who disobey and withhold their Visions will be punished severely...

718100312.text: I once wanted to travel to Inazuma to write a thesis regarding this decree, but it really does seem dangerous over there...

718100313.text: You'll be fine. You don't have a Vision.

718100314.text: H—Hey, don't say that! Just think about it, if people with Visions are already suffering, don't you think that those who go without would be even worse off?

718100315.text: I suppose I should just stay here in Liyue and finish my thesis in peace, then report back to the Akademiya in Sumeru with my findings as soon as possible. If I delay any longer, I won't hear the end of it...

718100316.text: Ah, right, I still have to thank you for showing me so many things. Take these as tokens of my appreciation.

718100317.text: I'll finish my thesis this time for sure!
